title: Minimal live SWAP5 + MODFLOW6 + Ribasim three-model window
execution_contract: Use one real FMR/SWAP joint trial from a frozen accepted origin for every coupling iterate.
Use one live MODFLOW6 prepared solve for the whole coupling window.
Use a fresh real Ribasim model instance from the same accepted Ribasim origin for every surface receipt trial.
Never merge independently executed SWAP candidates.
Ribasim receipt mismatch updates the surface coupling iterate and causes same-origin SWAP/Ribasim recomposition before publication.
Groundwater flux mismatch updates the MODFLOW boundary term and continues the same prepared solve.
Convergence requires MODFLOW nonlinear convergence, groundwater interface flux residual within tolerance, and Ribasim requested-versus-realized surface transfer within tolerance.
No model publishes accepted state before TRI01-C publication preflight is satisfied.

qualification_strategy.swap_bridge: qualification-only same-origin joint-participant bridge or executable; no production ABI claim
qualification_strategy.surface_water: real Ribasim same-origin candidate realization based on ADM01-G7 semantics

required_cases: D1 positive drainage to Ribasim with coupled groundwater response
D2 negative infiltration with sufficient Ribasim availability
D3 availability-limited infiltration requiring at least one same-origin surface recomposition
required_evidence: one prepared MODFLOW solve per window
real SWAP joint candidate on every coupling iterate
real Ribasim receipt on every coupling iterate
mass closure for SWAP groundwater interface and Ribasim surface transfer
exactly one final SWAP transaction commit under TRI01-B authority
